payload.reason: The evidence discusses various annotation schemes and approaches related to ESL (English as a Second Language) but does not explicitly define baseline models.

claims.text: The proposed ESL annotation guidelines focus on POS tags and syntactic dependencies based on existing frameworks.
Dıaz et al. propose three parallel POS tag annotations for lexical, morphological, and distributional forms.
The work emphasizes a multi-layered analysis to decouple observed language usage from conventional structures.
